DHAKA, August 21, 2022 (BSS) - State Minister for Planning Dr Shamsul Alam

today said that there is no crisis in the country's economy as Bangladesh is

moving ahead in a planned way while there is no weakness in the planning

process.

"Bangladesh is under discomfort to some extent due to the global situation,

but the country is under no crisis," he said.
